description: Core defaults plus the frameless title bar's custom window controls (minimize / toggle-maximize / close / drag), which call the JS window API. The Settings page native ops (shell-open the log folder, folder/save-file dialogs, Markdown export) are driven from Rust commands using the plugins' Rust APIs, so the shell / dialog / fs JS surfaces are deliberately NOT granted to the webview (least privilege — see test/capabilities.test.mjs).
